faq.question: Are the plans only for photo-video studios?
faq.answer: No. Free, Solo, Studio, and Agency apply to freelancers, teams, venues, and agencies in the events industry. "Studio" is the plan name for growing teams, not only photo-video.

faq.question: Can I change plans later?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade anytime from account settings, with no penalties.

faq.question: Do prices include VAT?
faq.answer: Displayed prices exclude VAT. The final invoice includes VAT according to Romanian law.

faq.question: Is there a trial for paid plans?
faq.answer: The Free plan is available indefinitely — ideal for testing the flow before upgrading.

faq.question: How does yearly billing work?
faq.answer: With yearly payment you get 1 month free: you pay for 11 months and receive 12. You save the equivalent of one month versus paying monthly.

agency.description: For complex operations and multiple teams.

items.question: Is EasyWedd Pro just a CRM?
items.answer: No. It is a Business OS for Weddings & Events: leads, proposals, contracts, payments, calendar, projects, automations, and client portal — built for the events vertical.

items.question: Is it only for photographers?
items.answer: No. The platform covers photo-video, DJs, bands, venues, planners, decor, beauty, catering, entertainment, transport, stationery, and event agencies.

items.question: Can I configure the platform for my business type?
items.answer: Yes. At onboarding you choose a category, and the workspace can receive recommended pipeline, proposals, contracts, tasks, and automations.

items.question: Do my clients need to create an account?
items.answer: No. Proposal, contract, and project can be accessed through the portal via a unique link, without a password.

items.question: How does it relate to EasyWedd?
items.answer: EasyWedd Pro is for vendors; EasyWedd is for couples. They form an ecosystem — advanced syncs are marked separately as "in development" where relevant.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.answer: Yes. You can downgrade to the Free plan from settings, with no long-term contract.
